_doc: Exceptions for scripts/cicd/secret-scan.js. Each entry excuses ONE exact value (sha256) in ONE exact file for ONE rule. No wildcards. Every entry needs a reason and an approver; changes to this file must be code-reviewed. Remove entries when the value is gone (the scan reports stale ones).

entries.reason: Public Firebase web API key of ai-project-4e149 (WEB_API_KEY fallback, line 39). Only used as the ?key= of identitytoolkit.googleapis.com accounts:signInWithCustomToken (line 74) — a client identifier gated by Firebase Auth, not a credential. Prefer moving it to POD_CONTROLLER_WEB_API_KEY in functions/.env.<project> and deleting this entry.
